test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P is sitting to the immediate left of V. R is sitting to the immediate right of T. U is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of S. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S. T is sitting to the immediate right of V. Who is sitting to the immediate left of Q?
solution:
**Given**: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

Based on the given conditions in the question, we get the following arrangements-

1. P is sitting to the immediate left of V. T is sitting to the immediate right of V. From these, we get-

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e77abeb7de9410cf989883a380f38ae67abf2ed14f73183a44beb4c6001ad988.png] 

2. R is sitting to the immediate right of T. U is sitting to the immediate left of P and immediate right of S. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S. From these, we get the final arrangement as follows-

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e20c7a4cbd812145a2dabf7ceb21bbcfe96b2d20b6ee2b5b9d4500d2b0fcc51c.png] 

Therefore, we see that R is sitting to the immediate left of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.
